description: This file defines functions and constants related to memory flush planning, including prompts, hints, date formatting, and plan construction logic for memory management in a system called OpenClaw.

methods.name: formatDateStampInTimezone
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a date string based on a specified timezone.

methods.name: normalizeNonNegativeInt
methods.description: Converts a value to a non-negative integer or null if invalid.

methods.name: ensureNoReplyHint
methods.description: Ensures the provided text includes a hint for silent reply token.

methods.name: ensureMemoryFlushSafetyHints
methods.description: Appends required memory flush safety hints to the text if missing.

methods.name: appendCurrentTimeLine
methods.description: Appends a timeline string to text, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: buildMemoryFlushPlan
methods.description: Constructs a memory flush plan object based on configuration, current time, and other parameters.
